author: Mark Atwood
text: OVERLAP: MIME-72l.57 (review) covers the same AES-GCM dispatch arm from the opposite direction — MIME-72l.57 documents WHY the explicit branch should be kept (descriptive error vs confusing generic OID message). MIME-72l.53 (now labeled opinion) argues for removing it. Fix team should handle deduplication; the engineering case for keeping MIME-72l.57's intent is stronger.
